paper_title: Helioscope Bounds on Hidden Sector Photons
notes: This is a theoretical/reinterpretation paper that derives bounds on hidden photons (dark photons) using CAST collaboration experimental data and solar physics calculations. It does not report its own experimental measurement. The main results are shown in Figure 6 with bounds on the kinetic mixing parameter χ, but since this is a reinterpretation rather than a new experimental or observational exclusion, it falls outside the scope of the AxionLimitBench which focuses on direct experimental measurements.
